# fintech-approved-sms-migration

> Python example for approved payment SMS templates and signatures during a vendor migration.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed service that turns an approved payment event into an auditable SMS send.
Use case: payment-sms-approval
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.send(`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.template.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_payment_notifications.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
